claim: Standing aside in the VOLATILE-UNCLEAR regime costs more in missed rebounds than it saves in avoided losses.
evidence: One week only (n=1): 11/9-11/13 SPY +2.58% while the account was flat; within that week chips fell 5-9% on 11/13.
test: On the ~300 daily SPY bars, mark each session classified VOLATILE-UNCLEAR and compare the forward 5-session SPY return and worst drawdown against other sessions; first 70% of dates to explore, last 30% to confirm.
use: None until tested. Any rule change would need a proposal and owner approval.

history.change: Data point, no status change: SPY closed 740.04 (-1.90%) on 11/16 (VOLATILE-UNCLEAR, no trades); standing aside avoided a falling day, opposite sign to the 11/9-11/13 week. n=2 sessions-weeks; still untested.

Data point, no status change: the 2026-11-04 AAPL dip-buy signal (blocked by the regime gate) would have returned +7.2% in five sessions (hypothetical). On 11/16 and 11/17 SPY fell 1.9% and 1.0% with the gate keeping the account in cash. Three mixed observations, still untested.
